GitDiagram
Turn any GitHub repository into an interactive diagram for visualization in seconds.
You can also replace
hub
with
diagram
in any Github URL to access its diagram.
🚀 Features
👀
Instant Visualization
: Convert any GitHub repository structure into a system design / architecture diagram
🎨
Interactivity
: Click on components to navigate directly to source files and relevant directories
⚡
Fast Generation
: Powered by Claude 3.5 Sonnet for quick and accurate diagrams
🔄
Customization
: Modify and regenerate diagrams with custom instructions
🌐
API Access
: Public API available for integration (WIP)
⚙️ Tech Stack
Frontend
: Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, ShadCN
Backend
: FastAPI, Python, Server Actions
Database
: PostgreSQL (with Drizzle ORM)
AI
: OpenAI o3-mini
Deployment
: Vercel (Frontend), EC2 (Backend)
CI/CD
: GitHub Actions
Analytics
: PostHog, Api-Analytics
🤔 About
I created this because I wanted to contribute to open-source projects but quickly realized their codebases are too massive for me to dig through manually, so this helps me get started - but it's definitely got many more use cases!
Given any public (or private!) GitHub repository it generates diagrams in Mermaid.js with OpenAI's o3-mini! (Previously Claude 3.5 Sonnet)
I extract information from the file tree and README for details and interactivity (you can click components to be taken to relevant files and directories)
Most of what you might call the "processing" of this app is done with prompt engineering - see
/backend/app/prompts.py
. This basically extracts and pipelines data and analysis for a larger action workflow, ending in the diagram code.
🔒 How to diagram private repositories
You can simply click on "Private Repos" in the header and follow the instructions by providing a GitHub personal access token with the
repo
scope.
You can also self-host this app locally (backend separated as well!) with the steps below.
🛠️ Self-hosting / Local Development
Clone the repository
git clone https://github.com/ahmedkhaleel2004/gitdiagram.git
cd
gitdiagram
Install dependencies
pnpm i
Set up environment variables (create .env)
cp .env.example .env
Then edit the
.env
file with your Anthropic API key and optional GitHub personal access token.
Run backend
docker-compose up --build -d
Logs available at
docker-compose logs -f
The FastAPI server will be available at
localhost:8000
Start local database
chmod +x start-database.sh
./start-database.sh
When prompted to generate a random password, input yes.
The Postgres database will start in a container at
localhost:5432
Initialize the database schema
pnpm db:push
You can view and interact with the database using
pnpm db:studio
Run Frontend
pnpm dev
You can now access the website at
localhost:3000
and edit the rate limits defined in
backend/app/routers/generate.py
in the generate function decorator.
Contributing
Contributions are welcome! Please feel free to submit a Pull Request.
Acknowledgements
Shoutout to
Romain Courtois
's
Gitingest
for inspiration and styling
📈 Rate Limits
I am currently hosting it for free with no rate limits though this is somewhat likely to change in the future.
🤔 Future Steps
Implement font-awesome icons in diagram
Implement an embedded feature like star-history.com but for diagrams. The diagram could also be updated progressively as commits are made.

data.article_summary: 美国新泽西州民主党参议员科里·布克（Cory Booker）在周一举行的演讲中打破了单人连续发言的最长时间记录，超过了1957年斯特罗姆·瑟蒙德（Strom Thurmond）创下的24小时18分钟的记录。布克从周日晚7点开始发言，警告唐纳德·特朗普政府对美国民主和人民构成的“严重而紧迫”的危险。他批评国会未能有效制衡行政部门，特别是特朗普的内阁提名和政策。布克强调，特朗普政府在71天内对美国人的安全、金融稳定和民主基础造成了巨大伤害，呼吁国会采取行动。尽管布克在发言中略显疲态，但仍得到了一些民主党同僚的支持。他的演讲并非技术上的阻挠议事，而是为了表达对特朗普政策的强烈反对。

Photograph: AP

Cory Booker speaks on the Senate floor in Washington DC, on Tuesday morning.
Photograph: AP
US politics
Cory Booker breaks record for longest speech by US senator in Trump condemnation
In speech that began Monday night, Democratic senator warns of ‘grave and urgent’ danger of Trump administration
US politics – latest updates
Oliver Milman
Tue 1 Apr 2025 19.19 EDT
First published on Tue 1 Apr 2025 09.17 EDT
Share
Cory Booker
, the Democratic US senator from New Jersey, has broken the record for longest speech ever by a lone senator – beating the record first established by Strom Thurmond, who filibustered for 24 hours and 18 minutes in opposition to the Civil Rights Act of 1957.
Booker’s speech, which began at 7pm on Monday night, was not a filibuster but instead an effort to warn of what he called the “grave and urgent” danger that
Donald Trump
’s presidential administration poses to democracy and the American people.
“I rise with the intention of disrupting the normal business of the United States Senate for as long as I am physically able,” Booker said near the start of his speech. “I rise tonight because I believe sincerely that our nation is in crisis.”
Booker said that he has heard endless stories of “pain and fear” from constituents who are both Democrats and Republicans due to the
Trump administration
’s policies.
“Institutions that are special in America, that are unique in our country, are being recklessly – and I would say unconstitutionally – affected, attacked and even shattered,” Booker said.
“In just 71 days, the president of the United States has inflicted so much harm on Americans’ safety, financial stability, the core foundations of our democracy and even our aspirations as a people for, from our highest offices, a sense of common decency.
“These are not normal times in America and they should not be treated as such. I can’t allow this body to continue without doing something. The threats to America’s democracy are grave and urgent.”
Emphasizing the roll Congress should play to hold the executive branch accountable, Booker decried his fellow congressmembers for failing to vote against the president’s cabinet nominees and other policies.
“The most powerful man in the world and the richest man in the world have taken a battle axe to the Veterans’ Association, a battle axe to the Department of Education, a battle axe to the only agency solely focused on protecting consumers against big banks and other factors that might abuse them,” he said. “What will we do in this body? What will we do in the House of Representatives? Right now the answer is nothing.”
As he approached a full day of speaking, Booker began to stumble slightly in his speech, but was still on his feet, making sweeping gestures as he spoke.
Booker evoked the Founding Fathers, Civil Rights leaders and lawmakers who stood up against McCarthyism in his calls for congressmembers to more assertively hold the
Trump administration
accountable.
Yielding to a question from Connecticut senator Chris Murphy, while retaining the floor, Booker rested a moment while Murphy recounted the longest speech in Senate history, given in 1957 by Republican senator Strom Thurmond to filibuster the Civil Rights Act.
“What you have done here today Senator Booker couldn’t be more different than what occurred on this floor in 1957,” he said. “Strom Thurmond was standing in the way of inevitable progress.” He added: “Today, you are standing in the way not of progress but of retreat.”
Booker’s speech is not technically a filibuster as he is not trying to run down the Senate’s time to prevent a piece of legislation from passing.
Instead, he has used his speaking slot to decry the Trump administration’s spending cuts, its attempt to abolish the Department of Education, the president’s attempts to bypass the judicial system and the removal of people from the US who speak out against the administration.

data.title: Ask HN: What are you working on? (March 2025)
data.author: david927
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：多个技术项目的进展和实现细节

不同观点：
• **[enisberk]** 认为在低资源音频分类中，标注数据是瓶颈，因此其研究聚焦于通过主动学习、迁移学习、数据估值和跨模态学习等方式，在少数据情况下获得良好结果。他创建了EDANSA数据集并改进了主动学习方法。
• **[taejavu]** 开发了一个简易的发票生成器，解决了移动端生成发票时现有工具界面笨重、强制注册等问题。他通过将状态存储在URL中，实现了便捷的发票共享和访问。
• **[andrethegiant]** 创建了pure.md工具，允许用户将网页转换为Markdown格式，避免了机器人检测，并能处理JavaScript较重的网站。他认为这可以作为LLM的全局缓存层。
• **[megadragon9]** 开发了一个类似于PyTorch API的机器学习库，完全从零使用Python和NumPy构建，旨在帮助初学者理解模型学习的底层机制。
• **[999900000999]** 创建了一个受万智牌启发的开源数字卡牌游戏，反对当前数字卡牌游戏的商业模式，希望通过开源方式让玩家有更多自由。
• **[maxwelljoslyn]** 致力于将传统RPG与计算机融合，批评当前虚拟桌面应用（VTTs）的局限性，并开发了一个实验性的应用来实现其理想的功能。

补充讨论：
• **[amrangaye]** 开发了一个基于GPT接口的“氛围编码”工具，可以将自己的女儿插入非洲童话故事中，并计划将这些故事在线发布，以推广非洲历史。
• **[greysteil]** 创建了mentions.us，用于监控关键词在多个平台上的提及情况，解决了Reddit等大规模数据源的技术挑战，但目前用户主要在免费 tier。
• **[mhuffman]** 更新了一个名为"Date Night Movie Player"的应用，用于远程情侣同步观看视频并聊天，具有一些有趣的功能如“啤酒休息”按钮。
• **[icy]** 开发了基于Bluesky’s AT Protocol的协作平台Tangled，旨在重新思考和改进GitHub的功能，例如堆叠PRs等。
• **[hedayet]** 创建了一个无AI、仅限人类社交的网络平台，强调隐私保护和与亲密联系人的简单互动，反对主流社交媒体的算法操控。
• **[kamranjon]** 经营一家小型公司，设计和3D打印16mm电影摄影机配件，同时在在线教育公司工作，研究知识追踪和学习路径。
• **[janosch_123]** 分享了其在电动汽车领域的经验，通过多个平台传播知识，并利用之前在转换伦敦出租车项目中的经验。
• **[itwenty]** 开发了iOS应用MergeFit，用于合并Apple Watch上的运动记录，解决了运动记录中断的问题，并实现了无互联网情况下操作。
• **[Saigonautica]** 开发了多个硬件项目，包括个人图书馆管理应用、量子RNG设备、E2E加密聊天设备等，强调了硬件迭代的缓慢和其持续创造的动力。

争议焦点：
• **低资源数据处理**：[enisberk]的研究和[megadragon9]对底层机制的理解在解决数据瓶颈问题上有不同的技术路径和侧重点。
• **数字卡牌游戏商业模式**：[999900000999]对现有数字卡牌游戏的商业模式持批评态度，并提出开源替代方案。
• **虚拟桌面应用的功能**：[maxwelljoslyn]对当前VTTs的功能不满意，提出了更具灵活性和创造性的解决方案。

这些讨论展示了不同开发者在技术实现、商业模式和用户需求上的多样化视角和实践经验。

data.title: Ask HN: Who is hiring? (April 2025)
data.author: whoishiring
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：不同公司和岗位在招聘软件工程师、AI工程师及相关技术职位的条件、要求和公司文化。

不同观点：
• **Omi（kodjima33）**：Omi正在寻找创始工程师，公司发展迅速，已有30万用户和200万美元的融资。他们要求候选人有实际产品开发经验，使用的技术栈包括Flutter和C，并计划转向React Native。候选人需具备消费级硬件产品架构经验。

• **OpenAI（delqn）**：OpenAI的云基础设施团队正在招聘Kubernetes、Envoy和Istio方面的工程师。公司提供构建ChatGPT和OpenAI API基础平台的机会。

• **SerpApi（davidsojevic）**：SerpApi提供从初级到高级全栈工程师职位，支持远程工作，使用Ruby、Rails、MongoDB和React.JS技术栈。公司文化强调透明度、远程工作和利润分享。

• **Guilde（sbrown12）**：Guilde正在寻找高级工程师，专注于数据模型的开发。公司提供远程工作机会，要求候选人具备后端经验，并使用Golang、Postgres等技术。

• **Fathom（madiganf）**：Fathom正在招聘全栈工程师，公司提供AI Notetaker产品，正在快速增长。公司文化强调高效协作和快速出货。

• **Forward（amays_fwd）**：Forward正在寻找高级前端工程师，要求有NextJS和设计经验，开发嵌入式支付功能。公司提供现场和混合工作模式。

• **Clio（cliornd）**：Clio提供多个工程经理、机器学习工程师和DevOps工程师职位，要求在多伦多、卡尔加里或伯纳比以外的远程工作。公司提供永久全职职位和福利。

• **Navico（danicriss）**：Navico是一家海洋电子公司，要求候选人具备Android平台开发经验，能够处理从传感器数据读取到业务逻辑的开发。公司提供混合工作模式，要求在奥克兰本地。

• **Stellar Science（StellarScience）**：Stellar Science招聘科学软件开发工程师，要求候选人具备物理、工程、数学或计算机科学学位，使用C++、Qt等技术。公司提供实习和全职职位。

• **Sourcegraph（dcsourcegraph）**：Sourcegraph招聘多个工程师职位，公司使用AI加速软件开发，提供远程工作机会。公司强调高复杂度代码库的开发和维护。

• **Articulate（ggralla）**：Articulate招聘AI全栈工程师，公司提供AI Assistant产品，正在开发AI赋能的学习工具。公司要求候选人具备AI应用开发的热情，提供全远程工作机会。

• **Fleetio（Fleetio）**：Fleetio提供多个技术职位，包括AI工程师和软件工程师，公司提供SaaS平台，管理车辆和设备。公司提供全远程工作机会和丰厚福利。

• **FinQuery（roycoding）**：FinQuery招聘AI工程师，公司使用LLM和传统ML开发产品功能，提供远程工作机会。公司要求候选人具备2年以上工作经验。

• **Shortwave（mayop100）**：Shortwave正在快速增长，招聘AI代理工程师和产品工程师，公司提供商业通信产品，要求候选人在旧金山现场工作。

• **EliotNest（fahimf）**：EliotNest招聘创始工程师，公司使用AI/ML打击欺诈，要求候选人具备高度使命感和工作热情，提供纽约现场工作机会。

补充讨论：
• **工作模式**：多个公司提供远程工作机会，如SerpApi、Guilde、Fathom、Forward、Clio、Fleetio、FinQuery、Articulate。而Omi、Shortwave和EliotNest则要求现场或混合工作模式。

• **技术栈**：不同公司使用的技术栈各异，如Omi的Flutter和C，SerpApi的Ruby和Rails，Guilde的Golang和Postgres，Navico的Android和C/C++，Stellar Science的C++和Qt。

• **公司文化**：一些公司强调透明度（SerpApi）、远程工作（Fleetio、FinQuery）、使命感（EliotNest）、快速出货（Fathom、Shortwave）和高效协作（Clio、Fathom）。

争议焦点：
• **远程工作与现场工作**：一些公司提供全远程工作机会，而另一些公司则要求现场或混合工作模式，这在候选人选择职位时可能引发争议。

补充讨论：
• **工作模式**：多个公司提供远程工作机会，如SerpApi、Guilde、Fathom、Forward、Clio、Fleetio、FinQuery、Articulate。而Omi、Shortwave和EliotNest则要求现场或混合工作模式。

争议焦点：
• **远程工作与现场工作**：一些公司提供全远程工作机会，而另一些公司则要求现场或混合工作模式，这在候选人选择职位时可能引发争议。
